card.title: The power of the pre-ticked box

body.question: Germany asks people to opt in to organ donation and has a consent rate of 12%. Austria has a very similar culture and economy but makes everyone a donor unless they opt out. What is Austria's consent rate?
body.reveal: 99.98%. Opt-out systems dramatically raise effective consent rates through the default effect. Most people support donation, yet under opt-in only a small share register, because they fail to go through the process.

probes.question: What is the default under an opt-out donation system?
options: Everyone is a donor unless they opt out

probes.question: True or false: the default effect is the tendency to pick whichever option is pre-set.
